Cons.Name: Sharpened Senses
Cons.Effect: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.

Cons.Name: "Ether Vision"
Cons.Effect: Upon using an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, Trigger gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. When executing a Finishing Move in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, Trigger gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color> increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Cons.Name: Concealment
Cons.Effect: When Trigger enters or extends <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disconnect</color> upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.

Cons.Name: Beyond the River of the Dead
Cons.Effect: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>. For every 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color>, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>, when Trigger hits a target in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> is consumed to deal additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
